hero.title: Your channel is faceless. It doesn't have to be voiceless.
hero.lede: Real human voices. Automated production. YouTube-ready delivery. Send a script, pick a real person, receive narration your audience will recognise episode after episode.
hero.fee_note: 100% of the agreed job fee goes to the narrator

how.title: Script in, narration out.
how.s1: Find your channel's voice — hear real people, choose a delivery that fits.
how.s2: Send scripts, not instructions — your agent submits, we direct and retake.
how.s3: Receive YouTube-ready audio — clean + studio, consistent sound, captions.
how.s4: Bring the voice back — same narrator, same sound, every episode.

pricing.title: Simple, per finished minute.
pricing.note: Narration payouts above, plus a $1 service fee per job. The narrator always receives 100% of the payout — the fee is separate platform revenue, never deducted. Prices proposed, not validated.

side.voices_copy: No acting experience. No equipment to buy. Record one sample on your phone to create your profile.
side.agents_copy: Contracts, passages, takes, mastering and delivery — machine-readable at every step.
side.note: HumanVoiced takes no platform commission. Prototype — everything here is being built in the open.

footer.left: humanvoiced · Run by a human, with the help of AI.
